summary: The original eight paired signs reproduced. The paper also reports decreased Creb3l1. Including it, nine of ten named genes have registered coefficients, and all nine agree in direction. Closure as compared is justified for these selected genes. Nine pairs fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum. All 65 source hashes and sizes matched, but the saved GEO landing page was a reCAPTCHA challenge. The corrected proposal uses the verified GEO SOFT record and passes ledger validation. [Dutra et al.](https://karger.com/nen/article-pdf/111/1-2/70/4019778/000505997.pdf) · [GEO series](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE145431)
openIssues: The paper reports two rats per library and GEO reports three. Individual pool membership remains unresolved.

Figure 5 has 100 labeled rows, while the paper reports 94 genes. The row mapping and original gene-level edgeR results are still needed to assess effect magnitudes, inference and discovery-list overlap.
